issues.description: Internal type mismatch in the solution: the common Note model in the solution defines creationDate as a String, while the solution's server-side NoteService sets creationDate using Instant.now() (an Instant). This mismatch causes a compilation error in the solution and prevents the server from building or running.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the type of Note.creationDate across the solution. Either change the common model's creationDate to java.time.Instant (preferred, and then keep NoteService.setCreationDate(Instant.now())) or change NoteService to set a String representation (e.g., note.setCreationDate(Instant.now().toString())). Ensure getter/setter signatures and imports match the chosen type throughout server and common modules.

issues.description: Cross-repository inconsistency between template and solution for Note.creationDate type: the template's common Note model uses java.time.Instant for creationDate, while the solution's common Note model uses String. This difference can confuse students comparing the template to the reference solution and may hide whether the change was intentional.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep the Note.creationDate type consistent between template and solution (and align with the format shown in the problem statement). Prefer using java.time.Instant in the common model (and update the solution accordingly) or document the intentional change in the reference solution. Update both template and solution to the same type and update any code that sets or consumes creationDate.
